# opal_script (Resource)

Script Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opal_script" "my_script" {
  name        = "MFA check"
  owner_id    = "7c86c85d-0651-43e2-a748-d69d658418e8"
  script      = "...my_script..."
  script_type = "REQUEST_REVIEW"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the OpalScript.
- `script` (String) The source of the OpalScript.
- `script_type` (String) The kind of automation an OpalScript performs. must be one of ["REQUEST_REVIEW", "REQUEST_DELEGATION_CONDITION", "CONTEXT_PROVIDER"]; Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `owner_id` (String) The owner of the service user Opal provisions for a `REQUEST_REVIEW` script. Required for that script type and ignored for the others, which have no reviewer identity. Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the OpalScript.
- `updated_at` (String) The date the OpalScript was last updated.
- `version` (Number) The version number of the OpalScript's latest version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opal_script.my_opal_script
  id = "32acc112-21ff-4669-91c2-21e27683eaa1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opal_script.my_opal_script "32acc112-21ff-4669-91c2-21e27683eaa1"
```
